A '''languages database''' was a piece of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming used by [[Siak-series protocol droid|''Siak''-series protocol droids]]. It assisted the droid in translating and understanding a number of [[Language/Legends|languages]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
